description: Current console-user direct role assignments and group memberships. Each membership is a separate table entry. Group-inherited roles are excluded. Grant Date is Unknown. In-panel filters and filtered CSV export; complete source coverage is checked before displaying the report.

panels.description: Live IMS user, role and group catalogues. Each list is bounded at 1,000 records; any incomplete response blocks the report. Client-side filters act only after completeness validation. Direct role links only. CSV is available from the panel.

options.defaultContent: Membership data is unavailable. Refresh and check the query error before relying on this report.

fields.jsonPath: ($assert($exists(_metadata.total_count) and _metadata.page = 0 and _metadata.total_count = $count(records), "Incomplete Users source: report withheld"); $string({"records": [records.($u := $; type in ["PERSON","EXTERNAL_PERSON"] ? {"user_id":user_id,"type":type,"full_name":full_name,"first_name":first_name,"last_name":last_name,"principal_id":principal_id,"email":email,"status":status} : {"user_id":user_id,"type":type})], "_metadata": _metadata}))
fields.name: Users

fields.name: Roles
